li.label: heartless
li.description: We have ignored so many pleas for help. We are monsters.

li.label: cruel
li.description: We keep turning away those who need us. It's eating at me.

li.label: indifferent
li.description: We rarely help anyone. Are we really that cold?

li.label: apathetic
li.description: We could do more to help others. We just don't.

li.label: cold
li.description: We've let a few opportunities to help slip by.

li.label: neutral
li.description: We help some, ignore others. That's just how it is.

li.label: caring
li.description: We try to help when we can. It feels right.

li.label: sympathetic
li.description: We've been doing good work helping others lately.

li.label: merciful
li.description: We answer almost every call for help. I'm proud of us.

li.label: saintly
li.description: We never turn anyone away. We are a beacon of hope.
